source: Aggregate statistics of the UK Biobank lifetime work-history questionnaire (Category 130; 117,588 participants who completed the 2015-17 online questionnaire), computed by the package authors under their UK Biobank application and taken from the reference tables of the accompanying paper (bundle v5.0).
disclosure: Only proportions, medians and counts. Every cell describing fewer than 10 people is set to 0; the counts behind every proportion, and all person-year and transition counts, are rounded to the nearest 10 (so suppressed cells cannot be recovered by differencing); transitions between occupation codes seen fewer than 10 times are dropped; proportions are rounded to 4 decimals. No individual-level record, and no participant identifier, is included.
